_about: Corrections to the Sync auto-dub. 'lines' are re-voiced with a clone of that character's own dub voice (samples in 'characters' are taken from the dub itself); 'edits' restore the original actor (names, screams) or trim stray dub words. start/end = seconds in the clip's English track.

lines.en: Bring me my bracer, then do what your mother says, understand?
lines.tts: Bring me my bracer, then do what your mother says, understand?
lines.was: partridge

lines.en: I let you kill it.
lines.tts: I let you kill it.
lines.was: I was going to

lines.en: So you're Mihály's sister? Little Erzsébet Szilágyi.
lines.tts: So you're Mihai's sister? Little Erzhebet Szilagyi.
lines.was: Miho's

lines.en: But in truth, it belongs to you, my love.
lines.tts: But in truth, it belongs to you, my love.
lines.was: Though in truth, it was inspired by my love for you.

lines.en: Come on!
lines.tts: Come on!
lines.was: I'm coming.

lines.en: Is Sigismund here already?
lines.tts: Is Sigismund here already?
lines.was: Is Zygismund already here?
lines.note: re-voiced whole line; dub line really spans 6.73-7.75 (forced alignment)

lines.en: Father!
lines.tts: Father!
lines.was: Wait.

lines.en: It'll be fine.
lines.tts: It'll be fine.
lines.was: (missing in the dub)

lines.en: Erzsébet Szilágyi is my betrothed.
lines.tts: Erzhebet Szilagyi is my betrothed.
lines.was: Herjibet

lines.en: Not nearly as jealous as Újlaki.
lines.tts: Not nearly as jealous as Ooylakee.
lines.was: we lucky

lines.en: The king is coming. Your Hungarian king.
lines.tts: The king is coming. Your Hungarian king.
lines.was: Kralj dolazi, tvoj, mađarski. (was: The King of Hungary is here!)

lines.en: Only the queen. The king is late, as usual. No doubt still amusing himself with his whores.
lines.tts: Only the queen. The king is late, as usual. No doubt still amusing himself with his whores.
lines.was: Samo kraljica. Kralj kasni kao obično, sigurno se još zabavlja sa svojim kurvama.

lines.en: Excuse me, daughter. Janko!
lines.tts: Excuse me, daughter. Yahnko!
lines.was: Oprosti, kćeri. Janko!

lines.en: That wolf belongs to me. You killed it on Serbian soil.
lines.tts: That wolf belongs to me. You killed it on Serbian soil.
lines.was: Taj vuk pripada meni, jer si ga ubio na srpskoj zemlji. (dub was still Serbian)

lines.en: But I gave it to your daughter.
lines.tts: But I gave it to your daughter.
lines.was: Ali sam ga dao tvojoj kćeri. (dub was still Serbian)

lines.en: Listen, this evening is very important to me.
lines.tts: Listen, this evening is very important to me.
lines.was: Slušaj, ovo veče je za mene jako važno. (dub was still Serbian)

lines.en: If you anger the king, don't you ever come back to this house.
lines.tts: If you anger the king, don't you ever come back to this house.
lines.was: Ako razljutiš kralja, u ovu kuću više ne dolaziš. (dub was still Serbian)

lines.en: So watch what you do.
lines.tts: So watch what you do.
lines.was: Zato pazi što radiš. (dub was still Serbian)

lines.en: I need Mara here with me.
lines.tts: I need Mara here with me.
lines.was: Mara mi je potrebna da živi uz mene, (dub was still Serbian)

lines.en: She helps me with everything.
lines.tts: She helps me with everything.
lines.was: pomaže mi u svemu,

lines.en: I can't give her to your court.
lines.tts: I can't give her to your court.
lines.was: ne mogu je dati na tvoj dvor.

lines.en: My lord!
lines.tts: My lord!
lines.was: Gospodaru! (original Serbian audio had been kept)

lines.en: Look at the state of you!
lines.tts: Look at the state of you!
lines.was: Pa kako to izgledaš? (was voiced by the daughter; client review: it is Branković)

lines.en: Wash up, get dressed!
lines.tts: Wash up, get dressed!
lines.was: Ajde, umij se, obuci se. (was voiced by the daughter; client review: it is Branković)

lines.en: You'll behave, won't you?
lines.tts: You'll behave, won't you?
lines.was: Ugye? Jó leszel. (was voiced by Branković; client review: an off-camera woman says it = Branković's daughter, voice match 0.35)
